project: Open Starting and Charging Service Evidence Database

scholarly_discovery_policy.rule: Use Google Scholar as the primary scholarly discovery and cross-checking source. Cite and ingest the original publisher, DOI, repository, or authoritative full-text record rather than a Google Scholar results URL whenever available.
fallback_sources: PubMed or other discipline-specific scholarly indexes when applicable

prohibited_actions: Import content from websites that prohibit automated extraction.
Treat government hosting alone as proof of public-domain status.
Treat GitHub repository licensing as proof that embedded manuals are licensed.
Invent source permissions or reviewer identities.
Import placeholder excerpts or fabricated checksums.
external_reference_only: Fluke Corporation materials without written redistribution permission.
SAE standards and papers without explicit redistribution permission.
OEM service manuals without explicit redistribution permission.
